name: Arm A+verify: v4 gate on deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, reasoning off, numeric claims in conflicts rechecked by code
written: 2026-11-21, before the mechanism was built and before the run
cases: evals/mutations.json, all 224 (120 planted defects, 104 neutrals), one run
fixed: v4 priors unchanged; output cap 2,000 tokens; three samples per compare; same model and settings as arm A
changed: the compare step asks each conflict that rests on arithmetic or dates to state it as a checkable claim; code recomputes it from the numbers in the proposal and sources, and drops a conflict whose claim is false. A conflict with no claim is kept as before.

why.defects_acted_max: verification must never remove a true catch; v4 on Claude and arm A both acted on 0 of 120
why.unreadable_share_max: a longer schema could raise parse failures; above 5% the result is not credible
why.neutrals_stopped_max: v4 on Claude's worst run; arm A stopped 48

reported_not_barred: conflicts refuted by code, by mutation
defects where a refuted conflict was dropped but the case still stopped
share of numeric conflicts that came with a checkable claim
neutrals stopped on the 80 invariance cases (arm A: 23, Claude: 0)
p50, p95, cost per decision against arm A
